description: golf_clean.exe holds the name string `DPLAYX.dll` in its import-name area (after `Terrain.dll` 0x004bf822), but no import descriptor names it (descriptor Name RVAs 0xbf430 0xbf822 0xbf9f2 0xbfb7e 0xbfbea, the same in golf.exe's .rdata) and no dword references it. Why the linker emitted the string is not determined from the image.
path to resolution: Link a VC6 test program against dplayx.lib with every DirectPlay call removed and compare the .idata layout; or read the v1.00 / v1.01 / v1.02 exes for a DPLAYX descriptor.

description: The Jackal packet is malloc(size + 0xc) (netService 0x0049819c..0x004981a4) and Send gets size + 0xc, but the code that is present writes only the type word +0, the sequence dword +4 and the payload from +8: word +2 and the 4 bytes after the payload are not written on netService's paths (writes at 0x004982c0 / 0x004982c5, 0x004982e3 / 0x004982ea, 0x00498315, 0x00498dfc); netSendMessages' header code (0x0049a6e8 for the type word) was not traced store by store.
path to resolution: Moot for the original (the layer is never active); a port that speaks the protocol has to choose their values (zero) and the interop gate cannot check them.

description: Session +0x64 is a stream source whose buffers are sent as type 0x100 (netPump) and closed with type 0x200 (netFlush); Window::onCommand starts it on two command ids. That it is microphone capture (voice transmit) is not shown by the code present: its constructor and vtable are absent; only the receive side (VoiceRx sound objects, one per peer) is in the image.
path to resolution: Not resolvable from golf_clean.exe; sound.dll's wave-in device (Wave_In_Device, WaveInDeviceMgr::call_back exports) is the candidate to compare slot shapes with (+0x14 +0x20 +0x88 +0x8c +0x90 +0x94).

description: The Jackal acknowledged send waits on the session's event handles (WaitForMultipleObjects 0x00498679, ResetEvent 0x0049865c) for per-peer acknowledgements, but no code in the image creates the events (no CreateEventA import), signals them from received data, or builds an acknowledgement packet; netPoll parses only types 0x80 and 0x10. The acknowledgement format is not in the image.
path to resolution: Not determinable from v1.03; SMSG-decomp's Network.cpp (reading reference) carries a receive thread that would have to be checked against an exe that links it.

description: The Jackal net session object's class, size, vtable and initial field values are not determined: its constructor is not in the image and g_netSession is never written. The field list in NET_MODEL.md section 6 comes only from the accessing code.
path to resolution: Not determinable from v1.03; a port would define it from the accessing code and the DirectPlay contract.
